pr.title: Stop Codex from parsing Claude Code's hooks module as a hooks file
pr.head: e60261ccd0cb9527479435f0f11ebb5a078d3002

summary: Projector shares its skills between Claude Code and Codex. Its root hooks/hooks.json contains a Claude Code module, which Codex cannot parse as command hooks.

The Codex manifest now supplies an explicit empty hook set. This stops fallback discovery from producing a warning on every session. The separate projector-hooks plugin continues to carry the command hooks used for event delivery.

groups.title: Keep each host on its own hook format
groups.kicker: An empty Codex hook set overrides default file discovery.
intro: When a Codex plugin omits hooks, the host tries hooks/hooks.json. That conventional file belongs to Claude Code here and contains a modules field, so the host emits a parse warning.

The inline empty set tells Codex there are no root-plugin command hooks. The packaging test also rejects removal of that override or addition of real root hooks, which would require users to trust them again after releases.

files.note: Declare an explicit empty hook set so Codex does not parse Claude Code’s module manifest.

checks.text: With isolated temporary installs and Codex 0.169.0, the base manifest emits the modules-field warning. This manifest returns no hooks, warnings, or errors from hooks/list.

files.note: Protect the host-specific discovery boundary while keeping actual command hooks in the separate plugin.

checks.text: All 31 packaging and release tests pass. This updated test rejects the base manifest without the hook override, and the existing checks still validate the separate command-hook plugin.
